tldr: Mercury in the 7th house: thinking becomes personal through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
body:
With Mercury in the 7th house, this part of you works through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict. Mercury describes thinking, communication, learning, writing, and the way the mind makes connections. In practice, this brings attention to the one-to-one dynamics that show you how you meet others and how you let yourself be met.

When this placement is supported, relationship patterns can become clearer while there is still room to choose differently. Mercury can become clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening.

When it is strained, you may hand too much power to the other person or make them carry the whole story. The harder pattern can show up as overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said.
gift: clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said around partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
